description: This source file contains the implementation of TalkModeManager, a class responsible for managing voice interaction features such as speech recognition, text-to-speech, chat session handling, and related audio focus and recognition control in an Android app. It handles listening, speaking, chat subscriptions, and speech recognition lifecycle, integrating with Android system services and external chat sessions.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Main class managing voice recognition, TTS, chat subscriptions, and communication with external services within an Android context, supporting voice interactions and lifecycle management.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures the chat session subscription is active, loading config if necessary.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the current session key used for chat and context management.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice interaction functionality, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Sends a wake command, waiting for a response from the assistant, and plays the response via TTS.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays a given text string using TTS asynchronously.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from external gateway, notably chat message events.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables playback of assistant responses.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Explicitly reloads the configuration settings.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks an assistant's reply text, managing playback and TTS lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts voice recognition listening.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Initializes and begins recognition using SpeechRecognizer.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition, with a specified delay.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles speech recognition result transcripts, manages interruption and finalization.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for silence to trigger finalization.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks whether silence duration exceed threshold to finalize recognition.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Completes recognition processing and initiates chat/session commands.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat session updates if not already subscribed.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a chat prompt including context and current transcript.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message and obtains a run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Awaits final chat event for a specific run ID within a timeout.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches the completion state of a chat run.

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Removes and returns the completion state of a run.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Removes and returns the text of a completed run.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts text content from chat event JSON message.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for latest assistant reply text after a given timestamp.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches chat history and extracts the latest assistant message.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Plays assistant response text via TTS, parsing directives and managing speech output.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Executes a playback session, managing TTS and speech lifecycle.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS playback.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Performs TTS playback of given text with optional directive-based configuration.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops TTS and resets speaking state.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Cuts off current TTS playback, optionally resetting interruption state.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines whether speech can be interrupted.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Cancels the silence/watchdog timer.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests system audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the TextToSpeech engine.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS utterance playback.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shuts down and releases TextToSpeech resources.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if speech should be interrupted based on transcript.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Checks if playback is still enabled and current.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Determines if playback was cancelled due to state.

methods.name: ensureConfigLoaded
methods.description: Ensures configuration is loaded, reloading if necessary.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the session service.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts run ID from JSON string.
